description: Two component solvent-free epoxy adhesive for construction joints and for monolithic sealing of cracks in screeds
whereToUse: Monolithic construction joints between fresh and hardened concrete.
Construction joints for the structural reinforcement of beams and pillars.
Construction joints on decayed industrial flooring.
Rigid, waterproof construction joints (e.g. concrete bed to tank walls).
notFor: Do not apply Eporip at temperatures lower than +5°C.
Do not use Eporip on wet surfaces (even though they can be slightly damp).
Do not cast fresh concrete onto hardened Eporip.
Do not use Eporip on dusty, crumbling or loose surfaces.

standards.value: meets the requirements defined by EN 1504-9

technicalData.label: Workability time (EN ISO 9514)
technicalData.value: - at +10°C: 90 minutes - at +23°C: 60 minutes - at +30°C: 40 minutes

technicalData.label: Open time
technicalData.value: - at +10°C: 5-6 hours - at +23°C: 3-4 hours - at +30°C: 1 hour 30 minutes-2 hours 30 minutes

consumption.basis: construction joints with a rough substrate, per m²
consumption.quote: construction joints with a rough substrate: 0.5-0.7 kg/m²

consumption.basis: construction joints with a very uneven substrate, per m²
consumption.quote: construction joints with a very uneven substrate: 1.0-2.0 kg/m²

consumption.basis: sealing cracks: per litre of cavity
consumption.quote: sealing cracks: 1.35 kg/l per litre of cavity

consumption.basis: bonding precast concrete elements or steel to concrete: per m² per mm of thickness
consumption.quote: bonding precast elements in concrete, or steel-and-concrete: 1.35 kg/m² per mm thickness.

packaging: 10 kg kits (7.5 kg of component A, 2.5 kg of component B). 2 kg kits (1.5 kg of component A, 0.5 kg of component B).
storage: 24 months in original packaging. Eporip should be stored indoors in a cool, dry place where the temperature is between +5°C and +30°C.
notes: 1) The sheet prefaces its consumption figures with 'Consumption varies, depending on irregularities in the substrate and the method used in application.
